name: Combined recording wattmeter and varmeter
aliases: combined active and reactive power recorder
summary: Recording instrument that logs active and reactive power together from shared current and voltage inputs.
description: This form represents one recording instrument that logs both active power and reactive power on the same time base. It is drawn at generator and interconnection points where the relationship between watts and vars matters, for example when checking excitation control or reactive power commitments.

Both quantities come from the same CT and VT inputs, so the symbol should show those connections once. It does not define the sign convention for import, export, leading or lagging vars, which must be stated so records can be interpreted correctly.
readingNotes: Check sign conventions for both quantities.
Confirm both channels share the same CT and VT inputs.
distinction: The combined recorder logs watts and vars together; a recording wattmeter logs active power only.
